PC:
If adenosine dose is > 0.4 mg
Debrief: You gave more than the recommended 0.4 mg of adenosine

If adenosine dose = 0.4 mg
Debrief: You gave an appropriate dose of adenosine (0.1 mg/kg)

If ice applied to face
Debrief: Your maneuver did not change the cardiac rhythm. Do not delay in treating the rhythm.

If adenosine dose < 0.4
Debrief: You gave less than the recommended dose (0.1 mg/kg) of adenosine. Ensure you used the correct adenosine administration technique.

If synchronized cardioversion @ < 6 J
Debrief: You should have tried adenosine before cardioversion

If synchronized cardioversion @ >5 J
Debrief: You should have tried adenosine before cardioversion and you used too much energy

If unsynchronized shock @ > 1 J
Debrief: You should have tried adenosine before cardioversion and you did not synchronize

If elapsed time > 240 seconds without intervention
Debrief: You should have administered adenosine (0.1 mg/kg) sooner

If time elapsed > 180 seconds without intervention
Debrief: You should have administered adenosine 0.2 mg/kg IV sooner

If adenosine dose > 0.8 mg
Debrief: You administered more than 0.2 mg/kg adenosine

If adenosine dose = 0.8 mg
Debrief: You administered an appropriate dose (0.2 mg/kg) of adenosine

If adenosine dose < 0.8 mg
Debrief: You administered less than 0.2 mg/kg adenosine.

If infant is not receiving supplemental oxygen AND elapsed time > 30 seconds
Debrief: You forgot to administer supplemental oxygen

If infant is receiving supplemental oxygen AND elapsed time > 20 seconds
Debrief: You remembered to administer supplemental oxygen

If time elapsed > 240 seconds without intervention
Debrief: You should have administered synchronized cardioversion sooner.

If synchronized cardioversion @ > 10 J
Debrief: You provided synchronized cardioversion at more than the recommended dose.

If synchronized cardioversion < 11
Debrief: You provided synchronized cardioversion at the appropriate dose.

If unsynchronized shock @ > 10J
Debrief: You provided an excessive, unsynchronized shock.

If unsynchronized shock <11J
Debrief: You provided an unsynchronized shock.
